morgan: Quick follow-up to the PM postmortem on KV cache issues. We need concrete playbook edits: short triage checklist, exact commands, pager rules for Dedicated customers, and owners with deadlines.
incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-cache-analysis  artifacts + traces uploaded.
priya: I can author the playbook escalation table. @ash can you draft the minimal on-call triage commands we want in step 0-10m?
ash: Draft below, keeping it terse for paging: 
1) pods: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 120 | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|OOM"
3) metrics: curl -fsS http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?svc=runtime | jq '.kv_cache.evictions, .mem.rss'
4) if evictions spike (>60/min): patch batch_size -> 1 and restart gateway:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --patch '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) post-restart smoke: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate prompt='warmup' --check-status
6) if unresolved after 15m -> page @oncall; after 30m page @runtime-leads; if Dedicated affected -> page @dedicated-esc immediately and cc @support.
emma: I'll add a tiny smoke-script (exit codes) and link to gist in the PR.
dan: I'll own the runbook update in docs/runbooks/kv-cache-playbook.md. Target PR by 2026-04-12.
morgan: Let's create tracked follow-ups now. I'll open INCs and post IDs here.
priya: Proposed follow-ups: 1) Playbook + pager rules (priya) - INC-8210 - due 2026-03-31; 2) Triage commands + smoke script (ash+emma) - INC-8211 - due 2026-03-29; 3) Runbook doc update + weekly detection job (dan) - INC-8212 - due 2026-04-12.
ash: ACK INC-8211. I'll include auth note for rt-admin dump and a safe dump command: curl -u svc-sre:*** -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz
emma: Gist: https://gist.internal/kv-smoke-check.sh (will include exit codes 0/1/2).
dan: PR link (when ready) will be posted in this thread for review.
morgan: Thanks. I'll track the INCs in the postmortem follow-up doc and mark resolved when closed. Please ping here when PRs merge. :thumbsup:
